quarterly_data.signal: Preliminary Q1 FY2027 business update (quarter ended September 30, 2026; unaudited, subject to revision): revenue is estimated at $18.5 billion to $19.5 billion versus guidance of $14.5 billion to $15.5 billion, 'primarily due to increased demand for AI platforms'; gross margin is estimated at 12.0% to 12.5% versus guidance of 10.4% to 10.8%, primarily due to customer and product mix.
